retirementReasons.activation_gate: Generic activation-interception metadata and nested gate traversal were removed with scene composition. Applications express wake/unlock state using ordinary native button callbacks and Compose-controlled presentation.
retirementReasons.interaction_tokens: Deleted shared gesture-classifier/token/velocity facade. Native engine owns gesture transport; the few retained control-specific thresholds and velocity decisions are private policies exercised by native collections tests.
retirementReasons.platform_env_binding: Deleted synthetic environment binding, raw-input primacy overrides, camera/inset coherence belt and platform probe subscriptions. Consumers bind native services and properties directly through Compose.
retirementReasons.tap_arm_seam: All assertions inspect deleted renderer tap-arm dependency records, echo timestamps, metadata dispatch and private armed-session storage. Native controls do not retain that renderer seam.
